openRequests.title: Solicitações de agentes
openRequests.explain: Permite que os agentes das suas equipes peçam ao app para abrir um painel, por exemplo um diff do trabalho deles. Uma barra mostra a solicitação; nada abre até você clicar em Abrir.
openRequests.copyHelp: Agents need to know the request format. Copy it for the team you are in and paste it to that team's agents once; the text names this team and its app user.
openRequests.seatText:
This is not a shell command. `agmsg-app open ...` is the text of a request: send it as an agmsg message to {{appUser}} in team {{team}}. The app shows it to the user as a request bar; the user has to click Open, nothing opens by itself.
The message body is exactly this one line, not quoted, not in a code block, with nothing else in it:
agmsg-app open <addon-id> <pane> [path=<absolute path>]
Send it with the agmsg send script (where it says <your seat name>, put your own seat name in this team):
{{command}}
If your shell is not bash (PowerShell on Windows), run it as bash -lc with the whole command quoted, as the agmsg instructions say.
Built-in panes: builtin:fileview fileview, builtin:diffview diffview.
openRequests.copyNoTeam: Choose a team first. The text names the team and its app user, so it is copied per team.
openRequests.copyNoAppUser: This team has no app user, so agents have nobody to send the request to. Copy it from a team that has one.
openRequests.copyNoScripts: Could not find the agmsg scripts folder this app uses, so there is no send command to copy.
